description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing API endpoints related to time configuration periods. It includes setup for mock services, data providers for various test cases, and test methods for API operations such as 'getOne', 'update', 'delete', and validation rules.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the TimeConfigPeriodAPI, testing retrieval, update, and delete operations for time configuration periods in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the API's getOne endpoint for retrieving a specific time configuration period.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the API's update endpoint for modifying a time configuration period.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rules for delete are not implemented.
